profile.name: Gaitanaki
profile.tagline: A traditional Greek folk dance of communal weaving.
profile.insight: Documented in Wikidata under Q5517375, Gaitanaki stands classified as a traditional Greek folk dance.
profile.profile: Gaitanaki is catalogued in comparative registers as a Greek folk dance. It forms part of the traditional dance repertoire of Greece, categorised as a distinct folk dance tradition. Specific choreographic structures, musical instrumentation, and regional practices remain undescribed in the foundational registry records. Further historical and ethnographic sources are required to detail its communal performance and movement vocabulary.
